newsitem.title: USA: GTI to divest its 71 percent ownership.
newsitem.headline: GTI to divest its 71 percent ownership.

text.p: GTI Corp Wednesday said its of directors approved a plan to divest GTI of its 71 percent ownership of Promptus Communications Inc.
GTI said it is continuing to explore potential transactions through Montgomery Securities.

The operations of Promptus will be reported as discontinued operations for the year ended Dec. 31, 1996. To allow time for the necessary accounting and auditing work, the company said management now anticipates announcing GTI's fourth-quarter and year-end financial results for the periods ended Dec. 31, 1996, on or about February 27.
